notes.title: ROSE - New Update Released!
notes.content: [p]🌹 ROSE Update Released![/p][p]Our latest update brings several important fixes and improvements:[/p][p] 🛠️ Fixes[/p][p]- The **crash issue** occurring during gameplay has been resolved.  [/p][p]- The **wood breaking mechanic** now works correctly.[/p][p]🎨 Improvements[/p][p]- Various **UI (User Interface)** bugs have been fixed.  [/p][p]- The **lighting system** has been enhanced to create a more immersive atmosphere.[/p][p]Your feedback is always valuable to us!  [/p][p]Enjoy the game! 🌟[/p]

tags.bug: - The **crash issue** occurring during gameplay has been resolved.
- The **wood breaking mechanic** now works correctly.
- Various **UI (User Interface)** bugs have been fixed.
